exposure: face-to-face verbal education for Stool Color Chart (SCC) utilization
video-based content delivery for Stool Color Chart (SCC) utilization
outcome: identification of newborns with pale stools and biliary atresia
cohort: Mothers of 2254 newborns less than 2 weeks postnatal age at discharge in southern India.
finding: The use of a validated Stool Color Chart (SCC) with standardized information leads to good utilization rates in southern India, and video content delivery is as effective as face-to-face verbal content delivery.
